title: The Ultimate Secret of the Tianji Record
next_chapter_hook: When Chen Ji touched the edge of the truth sealed for eons, the will of the Heavenly Eye pierced his Mental Sea like an ice awl—the next instant, he heard his sister Chen Nian's mournful cry for help in the endless darkness.

text.content: In the temporal-spatial rift, that gaze pressed down on Chen Ji's shoulders like tangible weight. As the Void trembled, an aged and authoritative voice emerged from the depths of the rift: 'Through a thousand-year cycle, you have finally arrived at this step.' Chen Tianming stood with hands clasped behind his back, Heavenly Fate power flowing around him like the Milky Way. His gaze passed over Chen Ji, falling upon that faintly discernible figure, a trace of solemnity flickering between his brows.

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji felt the Tianji Record Fragment in his Mental Sea violently trembling, the sensation of being watched making every hair on his body stand on end) Senior Chen Tianming, you said the real test is just beginning... What exactly is this gaze?

text.content: Chen Tianming did not answer immediately. He waved his hand, and a illusory screen unfolded before everyone. Within the screen, a blurred image emerged—in the depths of endless Void, a vertical pupil slowly opened, its pupil reflecting the destruction and rebirth of countless stars.

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji stared at the screen, his heart suddenly contracting) This... this eye, I glimpsed its shadow when I broke through. Is this the Heavenly Eye?

Chen Tianming's voice suddenly turned grave: 'No, it is not the Heavenly Eye. It is the Eye of Heaven—there is a fundamental difference.' He turned around, facing Chen Ji for the first time, 'The ultimate secret of the Tianji Record, I should not have told you at this moment. But it has already set its sights on you; hiding it serves no purpose.'

text.content: In the temporal-spatial rift, that figure grew increasingly solid. A pressure beyond Chen Ji's comprehension surged forth like a tide, as if the entire heavens and earth were pressing against his will. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul violently fluctuated: 'Not good, it's locating us!'

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji felt that pressure like a mountain pressing down on him, yet he forced his spine not to bend) Senior Chen Tianming, please speak! Since I, Chen Ji, have come this far, I will not be scared back by the truth!

Chen Tianming let out a long sigh, waved his sleeve, and the image within the screen abruptly changed—revealing a majestic Heavenly Gate. Beneath the gate, countless figures in white robes were forging a scroll emanating golden light. 'The Tianji Record's original name was 'Heavenly Fate Shackles.''

text.content: The screen's image continued to evolve. That golden scroll was repeatedly sealed, eventually descending to the mortal realm and falling into a young boy's hands—that boy bore a resemblance to Chen Tianming, yet was even more sharp and outstanding. 'I was the first person to break the shackles.' Chen Tianming's voice carried vicissitudes, 'But the moment I broke the shackles, I became its new prisoner.'

choice.prompt: Chen Tianming's words exploded like thunder in Chen Ji's Mental Sea. Chen Ji felt the Tianji Record Fragment sending waves of stinging pain—a warning from fate itself. How should he face this truth that overturned all cognition?

choices.description: Since Senior was able to break the shackles, then I, Chen Ji, can also forge my own path.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain Chen Tianming's recognition, unlock 'Heavenly Fate Resonance' state
choices.risk_hint: May provoke further attention from the Heavenly Eye

text.content: A glimmer of appreciation flashed in Chen Tianming's eyes: 'Good, with such spirit, you are worthy of bearing this burden.' He raised his hand, and a stream of Heavenly Fate power entered Chen Ji's Brow Center. In an instant, the Tianji Record Fragment blazed with golden light, and countless dormant characters flooded into Chen Ji's Mental Sea like a tide.

choices.description: Why should I obey the rules set by Heaven? I want to see for myself what these shackles have locked away!
choices.visible_reward: The Tianji Record produces unknown resonance, may trigger hidden plot
choices.risk_hint: Extremely dangerous, but may uncover deeper secrets

text.content: Chen Tianming's expression slightly changed: 'You...' Before he finished, the pressure from the Heavenly Eye suddenly intensified, as if responding to Chen Ji's provocation. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul exclaimed in horror: 'It's enraged! Chen Ji, have you gone mad!'

choices.description: Whether shackles or keys—what I want is to break the rules themselves, not struggle within them.
choices.visible_cost: Temporarily unable to obtain Chen Tianming's inheritance
choices.visible_reward: Unlock hidden clue: the true purpose of the Heavenly Fate Lock and Key
choices.risk_hint: May miss critical opportunities, but reveals entirely new possibilities

text.content: Chen Tianming remained silent for a long while, then suddenly smiled: 'Stepping outside the chessboard... interesting. But do you know, when I chose to break the shackles, I thought the same?' His smile carried bitterness, 'This third path, the cost may be greater than you imagine.'

The screen transformed once more. In the image, that youthful figure—young Chen Tianming—held the golden scroll in hand, laughed heartily toward the heavens, then the scroll shattered, scattering countless fragments across the mortal realm. 'The moment I broke the shackles, I did indeed gain the ability to peer into Heavenly Secrets. But Heaven will not permit any true freedom.'

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji gazed at that figure so similar to himself in the screen, a complex emotion surging in his heart) So, the Heavenly Eye's gaze... began from that moment?

Chen Tianming nodded, his voice like an ancient bell: 'Yes. It uses the Tianji Record as chess pieces, and the prophets of each era as chess pieces. I, you, even those before us... are merely ants being manipulated.' He paused, his gaze turning sharp, 'But the complete Tianji Record's true ability is not 'foreseeing fate'—it is 'rewriting Heaven.''

text.content: At these words, the temporal-spatial rift violently trembled. That gaze seemed provoked to anger, a devastating force pressing down on everyone like a tide. Mo Xiansheng cried out: 'It's trying to prevent this secret from being spoken!' Chen Tianming coldly snorted, his sleeves shaking, forcibly shielding everyone from that force.

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji felt the Tianji Record Fragment in his Mental Sea frantically trembling, seemingly resonating with some kind of power) Rewrite Heaven... so is this the true reason my sister was taken? Chen Nian, is she connected to this?

For the first time, afluctuation appeared in Chen Tianming's expression: 'You indeed sensed it.' He raised his hand, and the screen displayed an image of a young woman imprisoned by chains—that young woman bore a seven-tenths resemblance to Chen Ji, golden runes coiling around her body. Chen Ji's pupils sharply contracted: 'Chen Nian!'

text.content: In the screen, Chen Nian's figure struggled in endless darkness. Her existence interfered with the operation of surrounding Heavenly Secrets; any prophecy near her became unclear. 'Heavenly Fate Lock and Key... she herself is a key.' Chen Tianming's voice was low, 'The Holy Sect took her, not to use her—but to ensure she can never fall into your hands.'

choice.prompt: Learning the truth of his sister's imprisonment, Chen Ji felt a flame of fury burning in his chest. Yet before Chen Tianming, he had to remain calm—rashness would only make things worse.

choices.description: Since Chen Nian is the key, I must rescue her immediately! No matter what the cost!
choices.visible_reward: Obtain intelligence about the Holy Sect from Chen Tianming
choices.risk_hint: Chen Tianming warns: the timing is not right; acting rashly will only harm her

dialogue.content: Chen Tianming raised his hand to stop: 'Calm down. She is trapped in the core of the Holy Sect's Forbidden Grounds, where fragments of the Heavenly Eye's will converge. If you go now, you're not rescuing her—you're delivering yourself to death.' His voice was icy yet carried a hint of helplessness, 'Do you think the Holy Sect hasn't killed her all this time? Because they can't—she is a living shackle.'

choices.description: Please tell me, Senior, how can I rescue her without falling into Heaven's calculations?
choices.visible_reward: Chen Tianming teaches the secret technique 'Tianji Divination', allowing one to peer into part of the Holy Sect Forbidden Grounds' layout
choices.risk_hint: Needs time to grow, but gains a clear direction

text.content: Chen Tianming slightly nodded: 'Teachability is indeed present.' He flicked his finger, and a stream of light entered Chen Ji's Brow Center. In an instant, countless formation diagrams and guard layouts flooded into his Mental Sea like a tide. 'This is a memory fragment I left when I infiltrated the Holy Sect's Forbidden Grounds.' He paused, 'But remember—she is only the key, not the lock. To open the door, you still need one thing.'

Chen Ji suppressed the surging emotions in his heart and asked in a deep voice: 'What thing?' Chen Tianming raised his hand, pointing to that gaze still watching maliciously: 'It—the core of the Heavenly Eye.' His voice was like thunder, 'To completely break the shackles, you must destroy its core. Then, the restraints binding Chen Nian, the fate binding the prophets of each era, the Heavenly Laws binding all of humanity... will all collapse together.'

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji felt an unprecedented pressure descend upon his shoulders—this is no longer sect grudges, no longer cultivation struggles, but... the ultimate confrontation with Heaven) Destroy the Heavenly Eye's core... Senior, why didn't you achieve this back then?

Chen Tianming remained silent for a long while, those eyes seeming to reflect a thousand years of vicissitudes: 'Because I was alone.' He turned around, staring directly at Chen Ji, 'But you are different. You have the Tianji Record Fragment, people willing to share your Heavenly Fate, and...' his gaze swept across a certain place in the Void, 'allies who have yet to awaken.'

text.content: In the temporal-spatial rift, that gaze grew increasingly dense, as if it would condense into substance at any moment. Chen Tianming knew time was running out; his voice became urgent: 'Chen Ji, one last thing—the complete Tianji Record requires collecting nine page fragments. You currently have one page, and I have one here. The remaining seven pages are scattered everywhere...'

choice.prompt: Chen Tianming's words cut off abruptly; the Heavenly Eye's pressure was now pressing close. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul anxiously urged retreat, but Chen Ji had too many questions亟待解答.

choices.description: Where are the other fragments? I need to know all their locations! Even knowing just one more page is another chance!
choices.visible_cost: May be locked onto by the Heavenly Eye
choices.visible_reward: Obtain clear clues about one page of fragments
choices.risk_hint: Chen Tianming warns: speaking too much will also make it notice

dialogue.content: Chen Tianming's gaze hardened, then he whispered: 'Xuanwu Sect has one page, unknowingly activated by that youth Han Lie. The Demonic Path Holy Sect has one page, in Ye Qing's hands.' Before he finished, that pressure suddenly intensified, as if the Heavenly Eye had caught the keywords. Mo Xiansheng exclaimed in horror: 'It's locking onto the location!'

choices.description: A standing tree catches fire; there's always a chance. Senior, tell me the most important thing—how can I contact you?
choices.visible_reward: Obtain Chen Tianming's token, can summon his remnant soul for support at critical moments
choices.risk_hint: Safely leave, but may miss some critical information

text.content: Chen Tianming nodded with appreciation, taking an ancient jade pendant from his sleeve: 'This is called 'Heavenly Mandate.' When you have collected three page fragments, crush it, and I can sense your location.' He raised his hand and tore open a temporal-spatial rift beside Chen Ji, 'Now, go!'

choices.description: Since it has already set its sights on me, why not confront it head-on right now!
choices.visible_cost: Extremely dangerous, may die on the spot
choices.visible_reward: May trigger 'Heavenly Fate Resonance', possibly gain an unexpected breakthrough
choices.risk_hint: Mo Xiansheng strongly opposes: this is seeking death!

dialogue.content: Chen Ji suddenly raised his head, staring directly at that gaze! In an instant, the Tianji Record Fragment erupted with dazzling golden light, colliding head-on with that gaze. Mo Xiansheng screamed in terror: 'No! Have you gone mad—' Yet the next moment, something strange happened: that gaze actually faltered slightly, as if it saw something in Chen Ji that made it wary.

text.content: Just as everyone was in shock, a crisp yet mournful voice suddenly echoed from the temporal-spatial rift—that voice was faint as a thread, yet like a blade piercing into Chen Ji's Mental Sea: 'Brother... save me...' It was Chen Nian! Her voice was forcibly cut off by some power, but that momentary cry froze all the blood in Chen Ji's body.

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji's fists clenched tightly, his fingernails deeply embedding into his palms. His sister's cry for help was branded into the depths of his soul) Chen Nian... wait for me. No matter the cost, I will definitely rescue you!

text.content: Chen Tianming's voice rang in his ear: 'Did you hear? This is a wisp of her divine thought leaking out when her will resists the restraints.' He deeply glanced at Chen Ji, 'She is still waiting for you. So, survive, grow stronger—this is the only thing you can do for her.' As his words fell, that temporal-spatial rift suddenly expanded, an irresistible force pulling Chen Ji into it.

When the light faded, Chen Ji found himself in a hidden location at the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain. Moonlight was like water, sprinkling over him, yet could not dispel the coldness in his heart. Chen Nian's cry for help still echoed in his ears; the Tianji Record Fragment trembled slightly in his Mental Sea, as if responding to his determination. From this day forward, he was no longer thattrashdisciple merely seeking self-preservation—he was the inheritor of the Tianji Record, a destined enemy of Heaven, a rebel against fate.
